name: Soulknife
summary: A psionic rogue who manifests blades of psychic energy.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.short: Psionic dice for skill boosts and telepathy.
features.summary: You have Psionic Energy dice equal to twice your proficiency bonus (d6, growing with level). Psi-Bolstered Knack: add a die to a failed check you are proficient in. Psychic Whispers: telepathy with a few creatures for hours. You regain one die as a bonus action once per short rest.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.short: Manifest a psychic blade (1d6) and a bonus-action second one (1d4).
features.summary: When you take the Attack action, you can manifest a psychic blade: a simple melee weapon with finesse and thrown (60 ft.) that deals 1d6 psychic damage. Afterward you can attack with a second blade as a bonus action for 1d4 psychic.

features.name: Soul Blades
features.short: Spend dice to improve blade attacks or teleport.
features.summary: Homing Strikes: when a psychic blade attack misses, roll a Psionic die and add it, possibly turning it into a hit. Psychic Teleportation: as a bonus action, spend a die to throw a blade and teleport to it (10 ft. per point rolled).

features.name: Psychic Veil
features.short: Action: become invisible for an hour.
features.summary: As an action, you become invisible for 1 hour or until you dismiss it, damage a creature or force a save. Once per long rest (or spend a die).

features.name: Rend Mind
features.short: Sneak Attack with a blade can stun the target.
features.summary: When you deal Sneak Attack damage with a psychic blade, the target makes a WIS save (DC 8 + DEX + PB) or is stunned for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn. Once per long rest (or spend three dice).
